column7: What are the EU climate neutrality targets?
column8: The European Union has committed to achieving climate neutrality by 2050 or sooner [2] [4]. When aggregated, the national targets set by Member States are 6 percentage points short of the net-zero greenhouse gas emissions target for 2050 [2]. This commitment is part of a broader strategy aimed at reducing emissions and addressing the challenges posed by international aviation and maritime sectors [2].
